scope: Synchronous task toggle, three query/selector subscriptions and publication listener; optional all task fields or 15 visible rows plus completed count. No Flutter/React rendering, network or synchronous disk flush. Datafriend still executes database transactions/index maintenance/query evaluation; Redux only maintains JS state.

configuration.rtk: NODE_ENV=production, default middleware, Immer auto-freeze on, DevTools off
configuration.redux_manual: Redux createStore, hand-written immutable reducer; same selectors
